turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You asked for this meeting, Hale, and I have until 4:40. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Don't thank me. I asked who entered that zero and what it rests on. I'm waiting.
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Then why are we here? A favourite doesn't find out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class. What do you have besides compliments?
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"A misunderstanding." A misunderstanding doesn't go into a gradebook as a zero. Is it coming off today, or am I going upstairs?
So can we agree he's a good student?
You're leading me, Hale. I've done this for twenty years. His average is 91.2, and your zero puts his scholarship at risk, so either show me what it rests on or take it off.
